name: Dog Walking Lisbon
short_description: Pet care in Lisbon offering dog walking, pet sitting, boarding, and house sitting.

description: Dog Walking Lisbon provides companion animal care services across Lisbon. Services include dog walking, in-home pet visits, house sitting, and family boarding. Every assignment is preceded by an in-person meeting to evaluate pet habits and routines, supplemented by daily photo and video updates.

A oferta inclui passeios diários dinâmicos, pet sitting ao domicílio, house sitting e alojamento familiar. Os serviços contam com uma reunião presencial prévia para conhecer o animal e acompanhamento diário com fotografias e vídeos.

description: Malü Pet Care provides dedicated in-home pet sitting and dog walking services throughout central Lisbon. The service focuses exclusively on home care for cats and dogs, maintaining pet routines without boarding. Clients receive a free preliminary introductory visit as well as daily reports with photos and videos.

name: Cat Nanny Lisboa | Cat Sitting
short_description: In-home cat sitting visits across Lisbon with daily updates, care, and medication support.

description: Cat Nanny Lisboa provides specialized in-home feline sitting visits across the Lisbon metropolitan area. The service manages feeding, litter box maintenance, play sessions, and medication administration while pets remain in their familiar home environment. Visits include liability insurance coverage, introductory meetings, and daily photo and video reports.
description_local: A Cat Nanny Lisboa disponibiliza visitas de cat sitting ao domicílio em toda a área metropolitana de Lisboa. Os cuidadores asseguram alimentação, limpeza da caixa de areia, brincadeiras e administração de medicamentos no ambiente familiar do animal. O serviço inclui cobertura por seguro de responsabilidade civil, visita prévia de apresentação e relatórios diários com fotografias e vídeos.
